description:
At Byrne Malone we take great pride and pleasure in selling fantastic family homes and thus we are delighted to welcome you to 20 Whitethorn Place!

Tucked away in a quiet cul de sac and enjoying a picturesque view of the neighbourhood green, no. 20 is a beautifully presented three bedroom semi-detached home with an impressive A energy rating. With a generous end of row corner aspect, the interior is especially spacious, incredibly bright and immaculately maintained - literally ready to just move in and hang up your hat as they say!

Whitethorn is a welcoming, family-friendly community and this turnkey property presents a wonderful opportunity for buyers set down roots in a sought after Naas neighbourhood.

In brief the accommodation comprises of, a spacious entrance hall, sitting room, kitchen/dining area, utility room, downstairs WC, 3 bedrooms, main en-suite and family bathroom. On entering, the hall is bright and spacious with chic herringbone timber flooring. Located off the hallway on the left is a generous double aspect sitting room with elegant fireplace providing a lovely focal point for cosy nights in. To the rear, the heart of this lovely home, is the bright open plan kitchen/dining room. The contemporary kitchen units are a modern shaker style adorned with pewter handles and complete with integrated appliances . To cap off the practicality of the space is a fully fitted utility room (with ample understairs storage space) and a downstairs WC completes the downstairs accommodation.

Upstairs continues to impress with three generously sized bedrooms, all featuring lush carpeting that adds a touch of warmth and luxury. The main bedroom like the living room below is filled with light from dual aspect windows and boasts ample fitted wardrobes and a beautifully appointed ensuite. The second double bedroom also includes fitted wardrobes, while the third bedroom is a good sized single room overlooking the front. Serving these is a stylish family bathroom, meticulously finished to the highest specifications.

Outside features include a cobblestone driveway with space for 2 cars and an electric car charging point. From here a path leads past the front door to a secure pedestrian gate opening into the charming rear garden which has an south east facing aspect, thus benefitting from the best of the afternoon sunlight! Mainly laid in lawn it then has a lovely patio area, which essentially becomes secondary living space in the warmer months - the ultimate spot for lazy summer evenings!

With just a short 10-minute walk into Naas Town, you get to enjoy its unbeatable array of cafÃ©s, restaurants, shops, and pubs. Naas has lovely canal walks and cycle lanes along with superb countryside to enjoy at Punchestown and Naas racecourses. Whitethorn is ideally set on the commuter belt, 3 minutes to the M7 exit and only a short drive to Naas/Sallins train station. It has great local amenities including shops, restaurants, Primary and Post Primary schools, tennis, hockey, rugby, golf and GAA clubs.

So, if an A-rated, bright and spacious family home of distinction, situated in a fantastic Naas location is what you have been looking for, then this impressive home is a must see!
